name: bird-atlas
description: Wingdex · 生灵图鉴：本地运行的鸟类与动物拍摄图鉴，自动抓取维基物种资料，支持动物卡制作与成就收集

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @ba/web && npm run dev -w @ba/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ba/web && npm run build -w @ba/server && npm run build -w @ba/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @ba/desktop
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && npm run dist:portable -w @ba/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ba/server && npm run typecheck -w @ba/web && npm run typecheck -w @ba/desktop
